Key activities include inventory management, merchandising, customer service, checkout operations, and supply chain coordination.

Briefly describe the typical supply chain and replenishment process for retail stores outlined in the text.

The process includes product manufacturing, distribution center storage, shipment to retail locations, stockroom receiving, and shelf replenishment, often triggered automatically when stock levels fall below thresholds.
